Three-way directory button coexistence

Node has no DOM, so this is the only place the button surgery can be tested. The ACKS system offers two claimable header buttons and there are now three wizards, so one of them must land on the unpaired fallback — that is the case this fixture exists to pin down.

Serve the modules directory, not this module's directory, or the sibling imports below will 404: 

python -c "import http.server,socketserver; h=http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler; h.extensions_map['.mjs']='text/javascript'; socketserver.TCPServer(('127.0.0.1',8783),h).serve_forever()"
